Hey, guys. We just finished talking with [PERSON_NAME_0029]. And basically:

• Don't use Domino Delights documents for Zombie Match features, please. The system can be the same but There are nuances that create edge cases. For example, with daily login, because we don't have a queue manager yet, he had to do something else with the animations and that was one of the issues in the last week's meetings.  
• Because [PERSON_NAME_0029] tends to do small tasks and they can be popping in and out, he struggles with prioritization. Please take extra care with his tickets and consider his other tickets when you set priority for a new ticket. 
• Engineers struggle when documents are incomplete in quantity, a simple reward on our document can mean a bigger task on the client or backend side we can't anticipate as designers, so please make sure your documents are completed in this regard before you kickoff a feature. 
• We did remind him we expect documents to be a guide of its own without additional tickets. So let's make sure our documentation is complete at best we can.
